name: repogent
description: Turn bounded Python changes into independently validated, approval-ready patches.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose readiness or produce a verified patch
interface.longDescription: Inspect Git-bounded repository readiness without mutation, or validate bounded patch candidates with three explicit approval gates and retained local evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this repository is ready for Repogent without changing anything.
Use Repogent Verified Change to prepare an independently validated patch and show me the exact patch before applying it.
